claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, 2, and 3 show the metal frames and treadles of sewing machine stands.
The photos provide no evidence of the geographic location.

risks.risk: Seized or broken treadle and wheel mechanism
risks.proof: A video clip showing the treadle being pumped and the wheel spinning freely.

risks.risk: Cracked or welded cast iron frame joints
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four leg joints and the crossbar connections.

risks.risk: Rot or structural weakness on the underside of the table tops
risks.proof: Photos of the underside of both the blue and wood-grain tops.

proof_requests: Video of the treadle and drive wheel in motion for both stands.
Photos of the underside of the table tops.
Close-up photos of the frame joints to check for cracks or repairs.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the identity of the items as two SUMOPREMIUM sewing machine stands. They can be priced as stands only, assuming the worst-case mechanical and structural condition.
